UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile with role-based access information and union affiliation

union.description: Primary assigned union conference, mission, or attached field

assignedUnions.description: Official Step 4 voting union territories for division liaisons, or multi-union territories for coordinators/authors

inviteeUnions.description: Optional union territories where a division liaison acts as an Invitee (view and comment only, no Step 4 voting)

inviteeAllUnions.description: Whether a division liaison has division-wide Invitee (view and comment only) access across all other unions

isLiaison.description: Whether a super_admin (Division Admin) also acts as a Division Liaison with Step 4 voting power over specific unions

liaisonVotingUnions.description: Canonical unions where a Division Admin with isLiaison=true holds formal Step 4 Liaison voting power

unionConfirmed.description: Whether primary union affiliation has been confirmed

reconciledFromDocId.description: Optional pre-provisioned user doc ID verified during first login

Proposal.title: Proposal
Proposal.description: Strategic project and budget proposal for OneVoice27

pointOfContact.description: Primary project director / point of contact details

otherDivisionProject.description: Custom division project details if Other selected

reviewedBy.description: Name of certifying reviewer or officer

reviewNotes.description: Thread of timestamped reviewer and liaison remarks including optional readinessRating and section actionItems

unionApproval.description: Step 3 Union Committee Action metadata including vote number and date

liaisonVotes.description: Step 4 Division Liaison review recommendations, readinessRating, deficientCriteria, section actionItems, and formal votes

divisionApproval.description: Step 5 SSD OV27 Committee final project authorization metadata including certifying officer, date, and reference

activityLog.description: Chronological lifecycle audit trail across Steps 1 to 6 including project coding, phase, and status changes

focusId.description: External GC numeric strategic focus ID (1 to 3)

strategicProjectId.description: External GC numeric strategic project ID (1 to 7)

projectCode.description: GC project coding, locking metadata, and lifecycle phase/status tracking ({ composite, orgId, projectId, phase, status, locked, lockedAt, lockedBy, lockedByEmail })

audienceEDetails.description: Details when Audience E is selected

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Application event notifications for proposals and actions

targetAudience.description: Indexed audience tokens for scoped notification queries

readBy.description: List of user identifiers who read the notification

dismissedBy.description: List of user identifiers who dismissed the notification

AdminRole.title: AdminRole
AdminRole.description: Marker document designating a super admin UID

BudgetAllocationSetting.title: BudgetAllocationSetting
BudgetAllocationSetting.description: Union budget allocations and strategic KPI caps defined by administrators

allocations.description: Map of union names to allocated amounts in USD

matchingPledges.description: Map of union names to matching pledge amounts in USD

PublicMonitorSummary.title: PublicMonitorSummary
PublicMonitorSummary.description: Aggregated division-wide metrics snapshot for executive stakeholder quickview

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last snapshot sync

ActivityLogEntry.title: ActivityLogEntry
ActivityLogEntry.description: Audit log record for proposal lifecycle events

field.description: Optional changed field identifier (e.g. orgId, projectId, phase, status)

previousValue.description: Optional previous value prior to mutation

GcApiPrivateConfig.title: GcApiPrivateConfig
GcApiPrivateConfig.description: Admin-restricted external GC API secret key configuration

apiKey.description: Active secret API key for GC read-only integration

enabled.description: Whether external API endpoint is enabled

ProjectIdCounterSetting.title: ProjectIdCounterSetting
ProjectIdCounterSetting.description: Atomic per-union sequential project ID counter map stored at /settings/project_id_counters

counters.description: Map of union acronym to highest allocated sequence integer

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last counter increment

GcApiSnapshot.title: GcApiSnapshot
GcApiSnapshot.description: Precomputed Step 5 authorized proposals export payload keyed by SHA-256 hash of secret API key

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last export sync

envelopesById.description: Map of proposal or project ID to ExternalProposalEnvelope

/users/{userId}.description: User account profile and role details

/proposals/{proposalId}.description: Authenticated collection of strategic OneVoice27 proposals

/admins/{userId}.description: Collection of admin role marker records for security rules evaluation

/settings/{settingId}.description: Configuration documents (budget_allocations, kpi_caps, api_config_meta hash) and atomic project_id_counters

/private_settings/{settingId}.description: Strictly admin-only secret configurations including the live GC API key and public monitor share token

/public_monitor/{docId}.description: Aggregated stakeholder monitor snapshot gated by secret capability token or authenticated division_summary

/gc_api_snapshots/{docId}.description: Capability-hashed Step 5 authorized external export payload for server API consumption

/activity_logs/{logId}.description: Audit trail of proposal submissions, reviews, and committee approvals
